title: Why Highway Guardrails Have Heavy End Boxes 🤯
topic: Why highway guardrail ends feature a heavy steel box designed to flatten and redirect guardrail beams during a crash.
claims: Guardrail end terminals (extruder terminals) flatten and curl steel W-beams upon impact.
Plastic deformation of the guardrail absorbs the kinetic energy of a crashing vehicle.
Extruder terminals are engineered to redirect the flattened beam away from the roadway to prevent vehicle spearing.

title: Why Your Funny Bone Shocks You ⚡
topic: Why bumping your elbow's funny bone triggers an intense electrical shock down your forearm.
claims: The ulnar nerve runs close to the surface at the elbow joint.
Impact on the ulnar nerve produces a tingling or electric shock sensation down the forearm.
Lack of thick muscle and fat padding over the ulnar nerve at the elbow makes it vulnerable to direct compression.

title: Why Car Windshields Have Black Dots 🤔
topic: Why car windshields have tiny black dots along the outer edges (the frit pattern)
claims: The black border and dots on a windshield are a ceramic paint called frit.
Frit helps bake the adhesive that bonds the windshield to the car frame.
The dot pattern (halftone) helps distribute thermal stress to prevent the glass from cracking due to temperature differentials between the dark ceramic and clear glass.

sources.cite: Öztürk et al. (2024), Bulgarian Chemical Communications. doi:10.34049/bcc.56.3.ik-m
sources.claim: The black border and dots on a windshield are a ceramic paint called frit.

sources.cite: Lundevall et al. (2018), Applied Adhesion Science. doi:10.1186/s40563-018-0111-6
sources.claim: Frit helps bake the adhesive that bonds the windshield to the car frame.

title: How Mosquitoes Bite You Without Pain 🦟
topic: How mosquitoes pierce your skin without triggering pain receptors
claims: Mosquitoes use a fascicle containing a labrum, mandibles, and maxillae to pierce skin.
Mosquito saliva contains compounds with anesthetic properties that numb the feeding site.
The bending and micro-serration of the proboscis reduce mechanical stress on skin mechanoreceptors.

sources.cite: Wahid et al. (2007), The Open Entomology Journal. doi:10.2174/1874407900701010001
sources.claim: Mosquitoes use a fascicle containing a labrum, mandibles, and maxillae to pierce skin.
